en: An old black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with ornate floral borders. The upper left image shows a large, elegant corner building in late 19th‑century style, likely a hotel or civic hall. The upper right image is a panoramic view of a European town with rows of houses and a prominent large church or cathedral with twin towers dominating the skyline. The lower left image shows an ornate interior hall with arched windows, decorative ceiling, chandeliers, and a long bar or stage at the far end. At the center of the composition a ribbon with floral decoration bears the German phrase 'Gruss aus' (Greetings from). A smaller partial image of a stone bridge or archway appears at the bottom right.
